source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of protecting personal information (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Personal maloomat ki hifazat ka matlab hai apna data mehfooz rakhne ke liye qadam uthana:

items: Using Privacy Settings (privacy settings istemal karna): Social media par privacy settings is tarah set karein ke aap tay karein kaun aap ki maloomat dekh sakta hai. Misal: Apni Facebook profile private kar dein ta ke sirf dost aap ki posts dekh sakein.

Being Cautious with Public Information (sab ke saamne maloomat dalne mein ehtiyat): Public forums ya social media par personal details share na karein. Misal: Apne ghar ka pata ya phone number online sab ke saamne post na karein.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: https://www.nr3c.gov.pk par ja kar maloom karein ke koi student NR3C-FIA ka Cyber Scout kaise ban sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity: Cyber Scout jaisa program students ke liye kyun faidemand hai?
blocks.explanation: Trained (training le chuke) students apni class aur ghar walon mein online hifazat ki awareness (jaankari) phaila sakte hain aur jante hain ke cyber crime ki shikayat kahan karni hai. Program ki abhi ki details official website par dekhein.

items: Personal maloomat bachayein: privacy settings (Facebook profile private), public jagah par ghar ka pata ya phone number nahi.
